test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

He waves to me __whoever__ he sees me at the window.
solution:
The correct answer is: **whenever**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Whoever** is a subject pronoun and works like the pronouns he, she, and they.

 
 
• **Example -* ******Whoever **wrote this poem should win a prize*
 
 
 
• We use **whenever** to refer to any time or every t
